title: Carrow Charities Register — entry 1047-C: Fernhaven Seed Library
text: Fernhaven Seed Library. Registered office: Quay Street, Fernhaven. Incorporated as a charitable trust in December 2013. Charitable purpose: the free lending of vegetable, herb and flower seed to the public, and the promotion of seed saving as a means of preserving locally adapted varieties. Accounts filed to 31 March 2020: received.
notes: Official-register register. Plants the third conflicting founding answer: 'incorporated as a charitable trust in December 2013'. Also corroborates location (registered office) and purpose (charitable purpose clause).
